definitions.meaning: To take from, to take away

quotations.old_english: Ne wolde him beorht fæder bearn ætníman
quotations.english: the glorious father would not take the child away from him

source_text: æt-níman; p. -nam, pl. -námon; pp. -numen To take from, to take away; demere, adimere :-- Ne wolde him beorht fæder bearn ætníman the glorious father would not take the child away from him. Cd. 162 ; Th. 204, 5 ; Exod. 414.
